why: A read can be continued and a result is carried up to the head's budget. The device's declarations are unchanged (files.read already says 'pass offset to continue'; results.get and results.list were already registered), so the device request is unchanged: test_e1_request_ceiling measures tools 25,506 B and tools_wire 32,097 B as before. The hosted daemon's files.read takes the device's description word for word and it registers the device's results.get and results.list (PC-0118); those are not in the device request this gate measures.
